scope: Read-only inspection of existing OVH consumers and pure synthetic filter/sort/selection tests; caller external effects replaced with mocks.

semantics.sort_source: DEFAULT_SORT; tested code.filter sort/sort_by and code.sort did not override it.
semantics.size_limits_unit: MiB, compared to size_mb; numeric strings accepted, strings with GB suffix raised ValueError.
semantics.include_exclude_keyword_strings_in_direc: No effect observed in synthetic cases; not relied on for LTX selection.
semantics.strict_control: Per-subscription code.mode must be exact uppercase STRICT. No global brush/strict control setting was found.
semantics.strict_all_candidates_fail: find_torrent returns (None, false); caller skips download and all mocked persistence/notification effects.
semantics.nonstrict_all_candidates_fail: find_torrent returns an unfiltered candidate with false; caller still attempts download as brush traffic.
semantics.qualified_ltx_available: Retained as first selectable candidate when endpoint supplies LTX first and consumer DEFAULT_SORT is uc.
semantics.all_ltx_fail_but_other_uc_passes: Other qualified UC selected; preserving fallback resources is necessary.
semantics.no_candidate_profile_claims: No assertion of actual model quality or real download success.
